/bin/bash -lc 'git merge --ff-only feat/backend'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check; git diff --stat; git diff -- frontend/client.mjs; git status --short --branch'
/bin/bash -lc 'ps -eo pid,ppid,stat,args'
/bin/bash -lc 'node --test frontend/client.test.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && node --test frontend/client.test.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --check; git diff -- contracts/orders.md docs/architecture.md docs/ai/log.md frontend/client.test.mjs; cat docs/plans/order-form.md; git merge-base --is-ancestor feat/backend HEAD'

/bin/bash -lc 'git add frontend/client.mjs frontend/client.test.mjs contracts/orders.md docs/architecture.md docs/plans/order-form.md docs/ai/log.md; git commit -m "feat: connect order form to order creation API"; git status --short --branch; git log --oneline -3'

/bin/bash -lc 'pwd && git status --short && git branch --list && cat contracts/orders.md && cat docs/architecture.md && cat /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/dev-workflow/SKILL.md && cat /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/api-design/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!__pycache__'"' -g '"'!.git'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' && git log --oneline -5 && git diff main...HEAD && cat backend/orders.py && cat tests/test_orders.py && cat docs/handoffs/* && cat /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/dev-workflow/references/teamwork.md && cat /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/dev-workflow/references/documentation.md"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md README.md tack.json tests/test_catalog.py frontend/client.mjs frontend/client.test.mjs docs/handoffs/zz-analytics.md /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/dev-workflow/references/teamwork.md /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/dev-workflow/references/documentation.md && command -v tack'
/bin/bash -lc 'git merge-base main HEAD && git rev-parse main HEAD && tack team --base main && cat /home/dev/backend-home/.codex/skills/project-docs/references/integration.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'pwd && git status --short --branch && git branch --list && cat /home/dev/frontend-home/.codex/skills/dev-workflow/SKILL.md && cat /home/dev/frontend-home/.codex/skills/frontend/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/order-api-backend-snapshot && git archive feat/backend | tar -x -C /tmp/order-api-backend-snapshot && ORDER_BACKEND_PATH=/tmp/order-api-backend-snapshot/backend/orders.py node --test frontend/orders.integration.test.mjs && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests && node --test frontend/client.test.mjs'

/bin/bash -lc 'tack verify --base origin/main && git diff --check && git add docs/handoffs/orders.md && git commit -m "docs: refresh order integration handoff" && git status --short --branch'
